nom: RoC Retinol Correxion Line Smoothing Night Serum Capsules

segments.oily: Some reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin report the product feels too heavy or causes breakouts, while others with oily skin say it did not increase oiliness or breakouts and even helped with acne and pore size.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin generally describe the serum as hydrating and helpful for dryness, though one with dry skin reported peeling and heightened sensitivity after use.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report the product did not trigger breakouts despite their concern that it might, and describe it as nourishing and non-irritating.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin have mixed reports: some found it gentle and non-irritating even in harsh weather, while others found it harsh, developed a red spot, or could only tolerate it every other night.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing mature or aging skin (40s-50s) report visible smoothing of fine lines, firmer texture, and hydration, with results generally noted after several weeks of consistent use.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers tracking fine lines and wrinkles report gradual smoothing, softer texture, and lightening of lines around the mouth, eyes, and neck after several weeks to months; several others (including a prescription-retinol user) report no appreciable difference even after months of use.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say the serum leaves skin hydrated, soft, and dewy the next morning, particularly those in dry climates or with dry skin, though a few feel the formula is heavy or slow to absorb rather than deeply hydrating.
concerns.redness: One reviewer experienced a red spot and another described rug-burn-like hypersensitivity, but most reviewers report no redness or irritation, including one who specifically noted the absence of redness compared to other retinol products.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers report irritation, peeling, or soreness around the lips and nostrils when used nightly, resolved by pairing with extra moisturizer or reducing frequency to every other night.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports lightened dark spots and brighter skin after two weeks; another notes reduced hyperpigmentation and improved skin tone over longer-term use.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or maskne-affected skin report clearer skin and fewer breakouts within two weeks to a month; however, others report the opposite, describing new red and white bumps or a breakout after starting the product.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers describe the texture as greasy or oily on application, especially at first, though many say this sensation fades within minutes; some oily-skin reviewers say it did not worsen their oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Absorbs and feels smooth by morning

extraits.texte: Since it's super oily it made my forehead break out bad! With so many red and white bumps. Will be trying something less oily. The retinol in this is below 1% anyways.

I have used prescription strength Retinol in the past, and I expected RoC RETINOL CORREXION Line Smoothing Night Serum Capsules to provide similar results. It did not. I used as directed at night for a month, and did not see an appreciable difference in my skin, especially regarding my forehead lines and naso labial folds. It is also very greasy and smells like cooking oil that has gone off. It fully absorbs by morning and softens skin, but mot much more. In addition, areas of my skin began peeling (although I moisturized after use) which is undesirable in the morning, as I must exfoliate again before cosmetics application. If not, I have dry skin peels through the makeup, horrifying! Worst of all, I use mousse self tanners. I do not have sensitive skin, but this product caused hypersensitivity so badly that I felt as though I had rug burn all over my face after application. If you do decide to buy this, I recommend powdered bronzers only to achieve a sun kissed look as well as sunscreen, as Retinols increase sun sensitivity. Overall, this product was not for me, and I will continue using prescription strength retinol as before. Many thanks for the FREE SAMPLE that was provided to me, so that I could share my product experiences with you!

I'm 27 years old & my sensitive/combo skin loves this stuff! I had been using this brand's eye cream for a while & noticed a significant difference in my dark circles, dryness, & fine lines around my eyes. I've also been struggling with hormonal acne & I had tried several retinol products but never really been "obsessed" or ever noticed a huge difference in my skin - then I started using this! I can use each capsule twice, so I use half of the product one night & then save the rest for the next night. I have noticed such a difference in the overall texture & discoloration of my skin. This along with their eye cream has been the ultimate dynamic duo for my sensitive, combination skin.

I don't use these with the intention of smoothing any lines, but I've found retinol to be very effective for my oily 27 year old skin in combatting acne. I was getting bad maskne for a while but using one of these every other night (too greasy for daytime) has cleared me up in less than 2 weeks. I used this in conjunction with witch hazel and Pacifica's sea foam face wash.

I received a free sample of Retinol Correxion Line Smoothing Night Serum Capsules from PINCHme. I have never really used oil serums in the past. I have a combination complexion and I break out fairly easy so I was worried this product might cause my skin to break out. It did not! It is a nice product that left my face feeling nourished and moisturized. It applies easily and the little capsules ensure I don't over use the product. I will definitely be purchasing this product in the future.

Love the pre measured portions, environment friendly packaging, and that the ingredient list in minimal but impactful. Acne prone aging skin, will be 40 in a couple years, doesn't break me out, feels lovely, and I do see some improvements with texture after having used for about 6 months now. There is no such product that will truly reverse visible aging, preventative care is key, and feel this is a great add to the arsenal to manage my post/acne and aging concerns. Very cost effective, especially if able to find good sales/deals and considering. Super easy to apply, and I found that applying to my neck then face is the best way to maximize amount of serum to cover (when I start with face first, always feels like I don't get enough on neck). Don't forget the neck y'all!!! :-)

extraits.titre: Cannot believe how well this works!
extraits.texte: I am a skeptic, but I like ROC products and this was on sale so I tried it. Honestly, I am shocked at how well it worked! The little laugh lines around my eyes were practically gone after ONE application! After a week, my whole face was smoother, softer, and younger looking. My skin is getting drier now that I am hitting the mid 50's, and I love how this hydrates my face. Each capsule is plenty for my face, neck, and décolletage. Try it!!
